youtube.title: Why Cut Apples Turn Brown 🍎 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
A cut apple turns brown because of an enzyme called polyphenol oxidase. Inside intact apple cells it is kept apart from oxygen. Cutting breaks the cells, the enzyme meets air, and it converts natural compounds called phenols into brown pigments. Lemon juice slows this because its acid lowers the enzyme's activity.
